changes: Lowered confidence for all four scribe names from medium to low, because the name string is visibly corrupt and the split into separate names is uncertain

p2/p3: noted that 'रत्नविलासदेवाकुलां' and 'विलासदेव' may overlap or be split differently (e.g. Ratnavilāsa + Devākula), so the list may hold fewer or other persons

persons.name: Candrantadeva
persons.evidence: श्री चन्द्रन्तदेवः ... एते सहानुमतेन स्वस्वहस्तौ लिखिता

purpose: copied jointly by the named persons, each in his own hand, by mutual agreement (sahānumatena svasvahastau likhitā)
notes: Bendall leaves out the Sanskrit date ('Then follows the date (see above)'). He gives only the year, in his description: N.S. 983 in words = A.D. 1863 (983+880). Month, tithi and weekday are not available. The name string 'श्री चन्द्रन्तदेवः रत्नविलासदेवाकुलां विलासदेव-रत्नचूडामणिस्तथा' is corrupt. Possible readings: Candrantadeva may stand for Candrakāntadeva. 'रत्नविलासदेवाकुलां' might be Ratnavilāsadeva or Ratnavilāsa + Devākula. Vilāsadeva-Ratnacūḍāmaṇi might be two persons or one compound. The number of scribes, between three and five, is uncertain. The -deva endings are personal names, not regnal names. No king is named. This is Part 3 of a multi-volume Śatasāhasrikā set (see Add. 1627); the other parts may give the same scribes.
